scripts.dev:test-env: concurrently 'npm run server' 'npm run main-client' 'npm run alt-client'
scripts.e2e:main: start-server-and-test dev:test-env http://localhost:5173 'cypress --spec cypress/main-client/**/*.cy.ts run --browser chrome'
scripts.e2e:main:chromium: start-server-and-test dev:test-env http://localhost:5173 'cypress run --spec cypress/main-client/**/*.cy.ts --browser chromium'
scripts.e2e:alt: start-server-and-test dev:test-env http://localhost:5174/alt "CYPRESS_FRONTEND=http://localhost:5174/alt cypress run --spec 'cypress/alt-client/**/*.cy.ts' --browser chrome"
scripts.e2e:alt:chromium: start-server-and-test dev:test-env http://localhost:5174/alt "CYPRESS_FRONTEND=http://localhost:5174/alt cypress run --spec 'cypress/alt-client/**/*.cy.ts' --browser chromium"
